name: Cigánd (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Cigánd: a blue shield with a white figure and a bow, with a helm, a stag crest and red and yellow mantling, above a scroll inscribed CIGÁND.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Cigánd arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
